newsitem.title: USA: Delmarva sees 1997, 1998 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Delmarva sees 1997, 1998 EPS below estimates.

text.p: Delmarva Power & Light Co said on Wednesday that it foresees earnings per share for fiscal years 1997 and 1998 to fall $0.10 to $0.15 below Wall Street analysts' estimates.

Delmarva said in a news release that investments required to gear up for deregulated electric utility markets will result in earnings below the $1.76 per share expected for 1997, and the $1.87 previously seen for 1998.
Beyond 1998, the company said, its current investments in infrastructure, marketing and branding programs and new business should lead to earnings growth "significantly above industry average."
Delmarva said Wednesday's new earnings projections assumed normal weather and the timely restart of the Salem Nuclear Power Plant.
